updates.title: The core 0.1.10: the skill /release asks which product is released and checks that product's version
updates.whatToDo: Copy the 4 files from the release. When your project has skills of its own, do not copy `docs/workflow/skills.md`: run `make skills-catalog`, which writes it again. The skill `/release` now reads a table "Products" from `docs/releasing.md`: one row for each thing that your repository releases by itself. Your project has no such table yet. Run `/release` once: it proposes the table from your version files, package names, tags and workflows, and asks before it writes it.
